nodes.summary: Alternate mode normalizes screen/local coordinates, capture, focus, click and wheel; hits use committed geometry.

nodes.label: Focusable and CURSOR_MARKER
nodes.summary: Focused component emits zero-width cursor marker for hardware cursor/IME positioning.

nodes.label: Editor
nodes.summary: Multiline text, autocomplete, file/slash completion, bracketed paste and height-aware scrolling.

nodes.label: Markdown
nodes.summary: Themed Markdown with syntax highlighting and render caches; raw HTML is plain text.

nodes.label: Kitty inline images
nodes.summary: Kitty supports cropped viewport placements; alternate iTerm2 uses placeholders because deletion/cropping is unavailable.

nodes.label: CombinedAutocompleteProvider
nodes.summary: Combines slash commands and file path/@ attachment completion.

nodes.label: Terminal interface
nodes.summary: ProcessTerminal binds stdin/stdout and VirtualTerminal uses headless xterm for testing.

nodes.label: ANSI width utilities
nodes.summary: visibleWidth, truncateToWidth and wrapTextWithAnsi account for escape sequences and styled text.

nodes.label: Color values
nodes.summary: Indexed ANSI, sRGB, OKLCH and OKHSL values convert/mix and render in terminal color modes.

nodes.label: Darwin native clipboard
nodes.summary: AppKit provides asynchronous text/image/file-path clipboard and modifier-key state.

nodes.label: Darwin toolchain
nodes.summary: Apple clang/xcrun SDK or osxcross with SDK and Mach-O linker build arm64 and x64 prebuilds.

nodes.label: Linux native clipboard
nodes.summary: Asynchronous bounded-wait X11 reads use libxcb on glibc/musl x64 and arm64.

nodes.label: Linux clipboard fallback
nodes.summary: Unavailable X11 uses command tools; Wayland uses wl-paste and writes use existing CLI/terminal paths.

nodes.label: Isolated X11 clipboard tests
nodes.summary: Xvfb/xclip tests use isolated servers and skip unavailable dependencies.

nodes.label: Windows native clipboard
nodes.summary: kernel32/user32 provide console setup, modifier state and asynchronous text/image clipboard.

nodes.label: Windows native toolchains
nodes.summary: Visual Studio C++ or MinGW-compatible cross compilers build x64 and arm64.

nodes.label: Opt-in clipboard write test
nodes.summary: PI_TEST_NATIVE_CLIPBOARD test replaces real system clipboard content; only static documentation was read.

nodes.label: Alternate-screen layout plan
nodes.summary: Constrained alternate viewport keeps transcript scrollable and pending/status/widgets/editor/footer fixed in a dock.

nodes.label: Stable component tree
nodes.summary: Stateful components stay alive; internal frame layout boxes rebuild per requested render.

nodes.label: Internal frame geometry
nodes.summary: Transient rectangles, clips, ancestry, source mapping and hit-test state are private to TUI.

nodes.label: Leaf cache reuse
nodes.summary: Reuse Markdown/Text/Image/Box caches; avoid a second framework cache until measurement warrants one.

nodes.label: Axis-neutral allocation
nodes.summary: Stack allocator handles visibility, basis, grow/shrink, min/max and deterministic integer rounding.

nodes.label: Scroll chaining
nodes.summary: Unused wheel delta propagates inner-to-outer or stops at contain; non-scrollable dock falls back to primary transcript.

nodes.label: Focus and wheel separation
nodes.summary: Scrolling regions does not steal editor keyboard focus; cursor mapping includes offsets and scroll translation.

nodes.label: Visible-frame selection
nodes.summary: Selection and OSC8 links use committed composited screen rows with ANSI/grapheme-aware slicing.

nodes.label: Image layout limits
nodes.summary: Preserve vertically clipped Kitty transcript images; general horizontal image composition is out of scope.

nodes.label: Full final document
nodes.summary: Stopping alternate mode renders unbounded full root, strips cursor markers and omits terminal padding.

nodes.label: Coding-agent dock integration
nodes.summary: Stable transcript and footer containers compose flow main screen and viewport alternate screen.

nodes.label: ViewportTUI capability
nodes.summary: Constrained methods are available only through explicit alternate-screen capability and type guard.

nodes.label: Keyboard fallback
nodes.summary: Page/top/bottom navigation remains available without mouse capability detection.
